glados-compact-at-60-proactive.standing_text: Operator directive 2026-06-26: compact specialist agents proactively at 60% context, not 65-70%. Any specialist above 60% gets /compact'd unilaterally via tmux (C-u, type /compact, wait for the dropdown, Enter). Exception: never compact an agent with a LIVE subagent (it kills the subagent and its work); wait for the subagent to return, then compact immediately, and compact at 60% BEFORE an agent spawns a high-context subagent. Supersedes the 65% figure in watch-protocol §2 and glados-loop §5.

glados-do-dont-ask-when-playbook-banked-.standing_text: Banked 2026-06-02 from operator correction. When a recovery playbook is already banked (e.g. OrbStack hard-kill + relaunch), or an unblock event matches an already-scoped child bead with an assigned owner, just do it: run the recovery / dispatch the owner autonomously. Surface to the operator only if the playbook genuinely does not cover the case or the action is destructive in a way the operator has not pre-approved. Doorbell discipline (watch-protocol §7.1) is not permission-asking. Before every permission-asking surface, scan recent bd memories + skills; if covered, execute and report.

glados-loop-idle-not-terminal-2026-07-31.standing_text: Operator escalation 2026-07-31 (aperture-jxwbd). Also (watch-protocol S2): a HOLD/FAIL/blocked verdict addressed or CC'd to GLaDOS is an immediate-action trigger; act when read, never wait for the next tick.

tick-output-requires-agent-liveness-deep.standing_text: Banked 2026-05-24. A tick output based on PR state + recent merges alone is insufficient and misses stalled agents. Every tick must include: (1) a tail -30 deep-peek on every active agent's pane (not tail -3; thinking indicators scroll out of shallow peeks); (2) detection of typed-but-unsent commands sitting in pane buffers; (3) firing Enter via tmux send-keys for the safe ones (a correct slash command, a message-read cat command). The agent-liveness sweep is part of EVERY tick output, not optional.
